mapper.select: SELECT plan_id, user_idx, title, destination, start_date, end_date, is_public, share_token, created_at, updated_at FROM TRAVEL_PLAN WHERE user_idx = #{user_idx} ORDER BY plan_id DESC
select plan_id, user_idx, title, destination, start_date, end_date, is_public, share_token, created_at, updated_at from TRAVEL_PLAN where plan_id = #{plan_id} and user_idx = #{user_idx}

SELECT ps.plan_spot_id, ps.plan_id, ps.spot_id, ps.visit_date, ps.visit_order, ps.created_at, st.name, st.region, st.address FROM PLAN_SPOT ps LEFT JOIN SPOT_TRAVEL st ON ps.spot_id = st.spot_id WHERE ps.plan_id = #{plan_id} ORDER BY CASE WHEN ps.visit_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ps.visit_date ASC, ps.visit_order ASC
SELECT spot_idx, spot_id, name, region, address, latitude, longitude, description, rating_avg, review_count FROM SPOT_TRAVEL ORDER BY name ASC
mapper.insert: insert into TRAVEL_PLAN ( user_idx, title, destination, start_date, end_date, is_public, share_token, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{user_idx}, #{title}, #{destination}, #{start_date}, #{end_date}, #{is_public}, #{share_token}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.delete: delete from TRAVEL_PLAN where plan_id = #{plan_id} and user_idx = #{user_idx}
